versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the `oo-weixin-bot` skill for operating Weixin Bot through an OOMOL-connected account.
- Supports long-polling inbound bot messages with cursor-based update handling.
- Adds text replies and typing indicator controls for Weixin conversations.
- Supports sending image, video, and file media from public URLs.
- Includes media download/decrypt handling for inbound image, voice, video, and file items.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@75bac03`
